dialogues.jp:
一向に晴れない頭、そんな時でも朝はやってく
る。
dialogues.en: With my head as muddled as ever, morning quickly came.
dialogues.text: With my head as muddled as ever, morning quickly came.

dialogues.jp:
俺は学生だから、朝になれば学園に行かなけれ
ばならないわけで、
dialogues.en:
I'm a student, so I have no choice but to go to school in
the morning...
dialogues.text:
I'm a student, so I have no choice but to go to school in
the morning...

dialogues.jp:
……ああかみさま、それでも地球はまわってい
るのですね。
dialogues.en: ...Ahh, God, but life still goes on.
dialogues.text: ...Ahh, God, but life still goes on.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、ほとんど眠れなかったせいでいつもより
少々早めに着いてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't able to sleep at all yesterday, so I ended up
coming to school later than usual.
dialogues.text:
I wasn't able to sleep at all yesterday, so I ended up
coming to school later than usual.

dialogues.jp:
寝なければ遅刻しないというのは真実なのかも
しれない。
dialogues.en:
Although I don't know whether it was entirely because of
that...
dialogues.text:
Although I don't know whether it was entirely because of
that...

dialogues.jp: そんな俺の元に、脳天気な声が降って来た。
dialogues.en: From behind me, a never-changing voice rang out.
dialogues.text: From behind me, a never-changing voice rang out.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よーぅ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Morning, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Morning, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
まともに反応するのも面倒臭くて、単語にすら
ならぬ返事を返す。
dialogues.en:
Even giving a reaction was tiresome, so I settled for a
one-word reply.
dialogues.text:
Even giving a reaction was tiresome, so I settled for a
one-word reply.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ん、どうした？　今日は朝から覇気が感じら
　れないな」
dialogues.en:
"Mm, is something wrong? You don't look charged up for the
morning."
dialogues.text:
"Mm, is something wrong? You don't look charged up for the
morning."

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず鬱陶しい程元気なオーラを放つ杉並。
dialogues.en:
Suginami was giving off an irritatingly-energetic aura, as
usual.
dialogues.text:
Suginami was giving off an irritatingly-energetic aura, as
usual.

dialogues.jp:
「……生憎、普段から俺はそんなキャラじゃな
　い」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry, but I've never been a morning person."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry, but I've never been a morning person."

dialogues.jp: うめくような声で答える。
dialogues.en: I somehow managed to groan my answer out.
dialogues.text: I somehow managed to groan my answer out.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わははは、そう言われればそうだな」
dialogues.en: "Wahahaha, I suppose you're right."
dialogues.text: "Wahahaha, I suppose you're right."

dialogues.jp:
バカ笑いがいちいち頭に響く。ああ、悩みのな
い奴は｛うらや／羨｝ましい。
dialogues.en:
That stupid laugh echoed endlessly in my head. Argh, I wish
I was as trouble-free as that bastard.
dialogues.text:
That stupid laugh echoed endlessly in my head. Argh, I wish
I was as trouble-free as that bastard.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、それにしてもいつにも増して無気力
　度がアップしているな。恋煩いか？」
dialogues.en:
"But today, you're even more devoid of energy than usual.
Affairs of the heart, perhaps?"
dialogues.text:
"But today, you're even more devoid of energy than usual.
Affairs of the heart, perhaps?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Gwah!!!!"
dialogues.text: "Gwah!!!!"

dialogues.jp: 不意をつく一言に、思わず吐きそうになる俺。
dialogues.en: His unexpected question shocked me into motion.
dialogues.text: His unexpected question shocked me into motion.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「む、さては図星か」
dialogues.en: "Hm, bullseye."
dialogues.text: "Hm, bullseye."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は目を細め、げはげはとむせる俺を面白そ
うに眺める。
dialogues.en: Suginami looked at me suspiciously, narrowing his eyes.
dialogues.text: Suginami looked at me suspiciously, narrowing his eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「っち……違うっつーの！！　いい加減お前も
　そういうつまらん当て推量は…………」
dialogues.en:
"T... that's wrong!! Don't make half-baked guesses like
that..."
dialogues.text:
"T... that's wrong!! Don't make half-baked guesses like
that..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何を慌ててるんだ。別にふつーのことだろう」
dialogues.en: "Don't get so defensive. It's a normal matter, after all."
dialogues.text: "Don't get so defensive. It's a normal matter, after all."

dialogues.jp: 確かに、この感情自体はふつーなんだろうよ。
dialogues.en: It's true, affairs of the heart are pretty normal.
dialogues.text: It's true, affairs of the heart are pretty normal.

dialogues.jp: ただ、この場合その相手というのが……。
dialogues.en:
But considering the situation and the other person
involved...
dialogues.text:
But considering the situation and the other person
involved...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お早っす」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
やや高めの声が近づいてくる。それだけで俺は
びくんと身体を強張らせてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I heard a slightly high-pitched voice. My body immediately
started stiffening up.
dialogues.text:
I heard a slightly high-pitched voice. My body immediately
started stiffening up.

dialogues.jp: みるみる頬が熱くなっていく自分を感じる。
dialogues.en: I could feel my own cheeks starting to redden quickly.
dialogues.text: I could feel my own cheeks starting to redden quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おぅ、お早う」
dialogues.en: "Oh, morning."
dialogues.text: "Oh, morning."

dialogues.jp:
俺の複雑な事情を知らない杉並は、ごくごく当
たり前の調子で工藤に挨拶を返した。
dialogues.en:
Completely unwitting of my complicated situation, Suginami
returned Kudou's greeting as usual.
dialogues.text:
Completely unwitting of my complicated situation, Suginami
returned Kudou's greeting as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お早っす、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ah, ah... good... good morn..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ah... good... good morn..."

dialogues.jp:
普通に挨拶を返そうと、挙げた手は、錆び付い
たロボットみたいにぎこちない。
dialogues.en:
The way I threw up my hand in surprise, and how I replied,
made me sound like a robot.
dialogues.text:
The way I threw up my hand in surprise, and how I replied,
made me sound like a robot.

dialogues.jp: 声も不自然に裏返っていた。
dialogues.en: I couldn't recognize where my own voice was coming from.
dialogues.text: I couldn't recognize where my own voice was coming from.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、朝倉……顔赤いぞ。熱でもあるの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, Asakura... your face is red. Are you feeling warm?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, Asakura... your face is red. Are you feeling warm?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤は赤面する俺の顔をのぞきこんできた。さ
らりと前髪が揺れる。
dialogues.en:
Kudou peered closer at my red face, his forelocks dangling
in front of my eyes.
dialogues.text:
Kudou peered closer at my red face, his forelocks dangling
in front of my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「い、いや、そのっ……」
dialogues.en: "N, no, that's..."
dialogues.text: "N, no, that's..."

dialogues.jp: ど、どうしろというのだ。
dialogues.en: W, what should I say.
dialogues.text: W, what should I say.

dialogues.jp: これは一種の拷問だぞ……。
dialogues.en: This is the worst torture known to mankind...
dialogues.text: This is the worst torture known to mankind...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……あ！　まさか俺、お前に風邪移しちまっ
　たんじゃ……ごめんな」
dialogues.en:
"...Oh! Don't tell me I passed my cold on to you... I'm
sorry."
dialogues.text:
"...Oh! Don't tell me I passed my cold on to you... I'm
sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「違う、そうじゃない、そうじゃないんだ」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not it, that's not it at all!"
dialogues.text: "No, that's not it, that's not it at all!"

dialogues.jp: 済まなそうにうつむく工藤に慌てて首を振る。
dialogues.en: I hastily shook my head at the apologetic Kudou.
dialogues.text: I hastily shook my head at the apologetic Kudou.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほほ〜ぅ」
dialogues.en: "Oh-ho..."
dialogues.text: "Oh-ho..."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達を、杉並は興味深げなまなざしで見
つめた。
dialogues.en: Suginami was watching us with great interest.
dialogues.text: Suginami was watching us with great interest.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ、その目は」
dialogues.en: "...What's with that look."
dialogues.text: "...What's with that look."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いやいやいや。そういうことか、納得納得」
dialogues.en: "No no no. Do't worry, I understand."
dialogues.text: "No no no. Do't worry, I understand."

dialogues.jp: しきりと頷く。
dialogues.en: Suginami repeatedly nodded his head.
dialogues.text: Suginami repeatedly nodded his head.

dialogues.jp: 「なにが納得だよ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you understand."
dialogues.text: "What do you understand."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、いいんだ、いいんだ。安心しろよ、俺
　はそういう事に対して偏見は持っとらん」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing, don't worry, don't worry. I'm not prejudiced
against that kind of thing."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing, don't worry, don't worry. I'm not prejudiced
against that kind of thing."

dialogues.jp: にへらっとなまあたたかい笑顔を見せる杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami gave me a warm smile.
dialogues.text: Suginami gave me a warm smile.

dialogues.jp:
そういう事にって……おいまた何か飛躍してな
いか！？
dialogues.en:
That kind of thing... oy, what the hell are you thinking
of!?
dialogues.text:
That kind of thing... oy, what the hell are you thinking
of!?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うまくやれよ、工藤。温かく見守ってやるか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "Watch over him, Kudou. It'd be for the best."
dialogues.text: "Watch over him, Kudou. It'd be for the best."

dialogues.jp: などとほざいてウインクする。
dialogues.en: A thinly-veiled wink.
dialogues.text: A thinly-veiled wink.

dialogues.jp: 事情がのみこめない工藤は、きょとんとした。
dialogues.en: Suginami's words flew right over the clueless Kudou's head.
dialogues.text: Suginami's words flew right over the clueless Kudou's head.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並ィ！！」
dialogues.en: "SUGINAMI!!"
dialogues.text: "SUGINAMI!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は｛やっき／躍起｝になって机を叩く。
dialogues.en: I struck my table with my fist in desperation.
dialogues.text: I struck my table with my fist in desperation.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、お前も王子様を大事にしてやれよ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, treat your prince well."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, treat your prince well."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、なに……おい」
dialogues.en: "You, what are you... oy!"
dialogues.text: "You, what are you... oy!"

dialogues.jp:
ああ、どうにかしてこの男を黙らせることは出
来ないものか。
dialogues.en: Argh, why can't this bastard just shut up?
dialogues.text: Argh, why can't this bastard just shut up?

dialogues.jp:
勝手なことを言い残して、杉並はさっさと自分
の席についてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Once he'd finished saying everything he wanted to, he
returned to his seat.
dialogues.text:
Once he'd finished saying everything he wanted to, he
returned to his seat.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なあ、あいつ何言ってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what on earth was he on about?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what on earth was he on about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、……気にしないでいい」
dialogues.en: "Nothing... don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "Nothing... don't worry about it."

dialogues.jp:
俺は赤くなった頬を隠すように、片手でぎゅっ
と鼻をおおって答えた。
dialogues.en:
I covered my red cheeks with one hand, pinching my nose with
it as well.
dialogues.text:
I covered my red cheeks with one hand, pinching my nose with
it as well.

dialogues.jp: 不思議そうに首をひねる工藤を片手で追い払う。
dialogues.en: I quickly shoo'd away Kudou with my other hand.
dialogues.text: I quickly shoo'd away Kudou with my other hand.

dialogues.jp:
工藤が自分の席に戻ると、俺はようやくほっと
胸をなでおろした。
dialogues.en:
When Kudou finally returned to his desk, my chest felt that
tiniest bit lighter.
dialogues.text:
When Kudou finally returned to his desk, my chest felt that
tiniest bit lighter.

dialogues.jp:
まったく杉並め、妙なこと言いやがって。あれ
は、後で厳罰に処すしかないだろう。
dialogues.en: Goddamnit Suginami, stop saying those weird things.
dialogues.text: Goddamnit Suginami, stop saying those weird things.

dialogues.jp:
取りあえず、あいつは気づかなかったみたいだ
けど……。
dialogues.en: In any case, it seems like Kudou still hasn't gotten it...
dialogues.text: In any case, it seems like Kudou still hasn't gotten it...

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと斜め前の席にある、工藤の背中を眺
める。
dialogues.en:
He went back to his desk rather puzzled. I stared at his
back.
dialogues.text:
He went back to his desk rather puzzled. I stared at his
back.

dialogues.jp: 胸がきゅっと痛んだ。
dialogues.en: My chest tightened again."
dialogues.text: My chest tightened again."

dialogues.jp: （……だからなんでこんなに気になるんだよ）
dialogues.en: "(...Why am I thinking about this.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Why am I thinking about this.)"

dialogues.jp: ……まったく自分がわからない。
dialogues.en: ...Even I don't really know.
dialogues.text: ...Even I don't really know.

dialogues.jp: 俺はどこか、壊れてしまったのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: Where am I going to go from here...
dialogues.text: Where am I going to go from here...

dialogues.jp: ◆コイゴコロ警報◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sirens of Love◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sirens of Love◆

dialogues.jp:
昨日の一件から、妙に工藤を意識してしまう。
恋煩い……でも相手は男だぞ。
dialogues.en: The entire yesterday, I couldn't get my mind off Kudou.
dialogues.text: The entire yesterday, I couldn't get my mind off Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
そんな、工藤に対する俺のぎこちない態度を見
た杉並からは、無責任になまあたたかく、応援
をされてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Lovesickness... but the crush is a guy. Suginami, seeing my
hesistance and nervousness in talking to Kudou, started
talking irresponsibly trying to "help" me.
dialogues.text:
Lovesickness... but the crush is a guy. Suginami, seeing my
hesistance and nervousness in talking to Kudou, started
talking irresponsibly trying to "help" me.

dialogues.jp: 幸い工藤に気づいた様子なかったが……。
dialogues.en: Kudou was blissfully unaware as usual...
dialogues.text: Kudou was blissfully unaware as usual...

dialogues.jp: ……自分でもかなりヤバイと思った。
dialogues.en: ...While I continued to have unwanted feelings.
dialogues.text: ...While I continued to have unwanted feelings.
